light_description: Japanese 1974 high-gain distortion/sustainer lineage, later reissued under Maxon and documented as a classic transistor dirt design.
Historical second-generation D&S dirt model preserved in Maxon's documented family history.
Japanese 808 overdrive lineage developed by Nisshin Onpa engineer Susumu Tamura and marketed under Maxon and Ibanez-associated identities.
Maxon 9-Series overdrive descended from the 808 lineage with its own chassis and switching implementation.
Maxon overdrive with the 808-family tonal architecture and a clean-blend function, preserving the lineage while adding expanded headroom.
Maxon Sonic Distortion combining transistor and op-amp stages into a broad modernized distortion voice.
Maxon Distortion Master with high saturation and independent bass and treble tone controls.
High-gain Maxon 9-Series metal distortion preserved in the historical and current product lineage.
Maxon 9-Series soft-distortion overdrive model documented in the brand's historical range.
Maxon 9-Series organic overdrive model preserved in the documented dirt catalog.
Maxon vintage-voiced overdrive model from the 9-Series family.
Maxon Super Tube Pro+ extending the 808-style overdrive lineage with additional tonal range and operating options.
Maxon 9-Series tube-oriented booster/overdrive retained as a named dirt product in the historical catalog.
Maxon 9-Series tube-based overdrive product preserved in the documented catalog.
Modern expanded Maxon overdrive based on the OD808 family with increased range and output.
Modern Maxon Pro+ evolution of the OD-9 family, documented as a higher-powered overdrive variant.
Maxon Fuzz Elements family pedal documented in the brand's fuzz range.
Sho Iwata's first Noel pedal, a handmade Japanese fuzz introduced around 2010/2012 and inspired by early Russian Big Muff/Civil War tones.
Rebuilt Noel Muff-family fuzz retaining the Cornet concept in a later handmade form.
Named Noel overdrive model from the EtudeImage-era product lineage.
Named Noel handmade overdrive from the builder's catalog lineage.
Named Noel overdrive product preserved in historical Japanese Noel catalog references.
Japanese tube overdrive introduced by Masatone Effectifiers as part of its original brand product line.
Japanese high-gain distortion designed for hard-rock riff and lead applications, with a broad range from glassy crunch to saturated drive.
